patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gusto and Personio share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Gusto and Personio share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Gusto only if your buying job matches “US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 + $12; Pre” rather than Personio's shape. Choose Personio only if your buying job matches “EU mid-market HRIS — Core from €7.60 PEPM (no USD list); CorePro and Recruiting/Payroll ap” rather than Gusto's shape. Workflow advantage: Gusto leans payroll-benefits; Personio leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gusto and Personio share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Gusto is US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 + $12; Premium $180 + $22.; Personio is EU mid-market HRIS — Core from €7.60 PEPM (no USD list); CorePro and Recruiting/Payroll apps are quote-led; 12-month annual minimum..
- Company-size focus: Gusto (micro, small-business) vs Personio (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Gusto-leaning payroll-benefits vs Personio-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Gusto — Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus; Personio — No USD list price — Core floor is EUR; Apps and CorePro are quotes.

Limitations — Gusto: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus; People/HRIS depth is light versus BambooHR; Gusto is payroll-first; Personio: No USD list price — Core floor is EUR; Apps and CorePro are quotes; Recruiting and full payroll are Apps, not Core.

Poor-fit cases: Gusto is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus · Personio is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No USD list price — Core floor is EUR; Apps and CorePro are quotes · Avoid Gusto if you actually need Personio's motion (EU mid-market HRIS — Core from €7.60 PEPM (no USD list); CorePro and Recruiting/)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
